wins: Maintained consistent average reward (80.00) across single episode, indicating actions were at least validly reaching reward thresholds.
Engaged mentor guidance 10 times, ensuring feedback loop for potential corrective steps.
fails: Zero percent success rate despite high reward implies episode terminated without achieving primary goal.
Multiple steps likely focused on incorrect target, preventing mission completion even though reward signals were triggered.
key_outcomes.summary: Training run achieved intermediate rewards but failed to produce successful outcome; repeated dependence on mentor guidance and lack of goal completion highlight need to refine attack path selection.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Attack execution stalled after initial reconnaissance; no prioritized exploitation target selected leading to episode timeout/fail.
